channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kemba Walker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kemba Walker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Blatt on Mike James, Kemba Walker
item.description:
Christos Tsaltas:David Blatt on Kemba Walker at @SportalgrG:

“I can say that I am happy for Kemba, that he has found a new home. He will have the challenge of playing in the Euroleague. It is very interesting that he will be on the same team with a player like Mike James”

David Blatt on Mike James, Kemba Walker, Jul 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @Tsaltas46.

item.title: Mike Batiste on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Christos Tsaltas:Mike Batiste on Kemba Walker at @SportalgrG:

“From the time we worked together in Charlotte what I remember is that Kemba was a leader with what he did on and off the court. I can't wait to see him play and showcase his talent in Europe”

Mike Batiste on Kemba Walker, Jul 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @Tsaltas46.

item.title: John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Dwight Howard, Kemba Walker
item.description:
“I feel like I was on the edge of kinda getting pushed out myself. If I wasn’t a true professional last year and the Clippers didn’t give me a chance, I don’t know if I’d probably been here right now. “We have so many great guys that can be like (Carmelo Anthony), Dwight [Howard], … even Kemba Walker. … You need veteran guys to help these young teams out as much as possible.”

John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Dwight Howard, Kemba Walker, Nov 19, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Evan Fournier on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Fred Katz:Evan Fournier on Kemba Walker:

“He’s just a big-time professional. That’s all I can say. Great guy.”

Evan Fournier on Kemba Walker, Dec 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Brad Stevens on trading Kemba Walker:

“We have a lot of things we have to address appropriately and this was really hard. This was not a first few weeks on the job move, just because of the kind of person he is, how professional he is and how good of a player he continues to be.”

Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker, Jun 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Keith Smith:Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker:

“He's going to go through warmups and we'll see how he feels. The anticipation is that he'll play, but we'll have a conversation after he warms up.”

Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker, May 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker:

“We are constantly going to the drawing board to find ways to make his life easier.”

Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker, Sep 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker:

“He’s a fighter, he’s a competitor, and he’s talked all year about wanting to win.”

Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker, Aug 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker:

“Every indication is he will be available when we are playing games.”

Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker, Jul 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Kendrick Nunn on Kemba Walker
item.description:
While answering Twitter questions,Nunn revealed his ultimate rookie challenge.

“The toughest player I’ve had to guard in the league was Kemba Walker,”

Kendrick Nunn on Kemba Walker, May 28, 2020. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Mark Murphy:Orlando's Steve Clifford on his former Charlotte star:

“I know (Kemba Walker is) greatly enjoying his teammates, playing for Brad, living in Boston,and the fact he doesn’t have to make every play. He never complained, but he’s perceptive enough to know it’s good for him.”

Steve Clifford on Kemba Walker, Jan 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @Murf56.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker's leadership to @ZoandBertrand:

“I think that humility is one of his greatest strengths. I don't think you can fake it. I think it's real.”

Brad Stevens on Kemba Walker, Dec 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Kyrie on Kemba Walker:

“We should have probably trapped him a little bit more like every other team does in the league. He torches us every time. It's no surprise.”

Kyrie Irving on Kemba Walker, Mar 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Kemba Walker:

“He's a nightmare. He's as good as you can get in the pick-and-roll offensive attack. He's a great shooter. He's quick. He's tough. He can score over bigs. We're gonna have to do the best we can.”

Scott Brooks on Kemba Walker, Feb 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: James Borrego on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Charlotte coach James Borrego on Kemba Walker:

“It's not a secret he's a free agent coming up, so our No. 1 recruiting pitch is to Kemba Walker right now. He understands that and he's playing like it. So that's our No. 1 target.”

James Borrego on Kemba Walker, Jan 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Alvin Gentry on defense being a key to win at Charlotte:

“Any time you can look at Kemba (Walker’s) line and he goes 5 for 16 (shooting), I thought Jrue did a great job on him,because he’s been scoring like crazy lately.”

Alvin Gentry on Kemba Walker, Dec 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Kemba Walker
item.description:
“(Walker) is a player that we hope is with us, not only for the next couple of years, but he ends his career here.”

Mitch Kupchak on Kemba Walker, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Charlotte Observer.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Kemba Walker
item.description:
#Hornets HCSteve Clifford:

“Kemba (Walker) is the ultimate competitor. He's certainly put himself in consideration to being an All-Star.”

Steve Clifford on Kemba Walker, Nov 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @BrianDulik.

item.title: Frank Kaminsky on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Frank Kaminsky on Kemba Walker:

“He's kept us in a lot of games when other guys weren't playing well... he deserves to be an All-Star.”

Frank Kaminsky on Kemba Walker, Jan 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Ty Lawson on Allen Iverson, Kemba Walker
item.description:
Ty Lawson:

“When I was young, I watched Allen Iverson do it to escape defenders. I started practicing it when I was 11. It's a tough shot. You have to have a knack for getting space. Kemba Walker does it a lot. He has a crossover and a nice step-back. I'm not going to lie, Kemba does it real nice. The times he used it in college [at UConn], man, they were great.”

Ty Lawson on Allen Iverson, Kemba Walker, Dec 12, 2014. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: LeBron James on Al Jefferson, Kemba Walker
item.description:
Michael Scotto:LeBron James on the Charlotte Bobcats:

“They're a team on the uprise. We saw it with Big Al (Jefferson) and Kemba Walker.”

LeBron James on Al Jefferson, Kemba Walker, Apr 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Al Jefferson on Kemba Walker
item.description:
Jefferson said of Steve Clifford and his assistants.

“That showed me that MJ [team chairman Michael Jordan], Rod [Higgins, Charlotte president of basketball operations] and those guys, they went and got a great coach and staff. That let me know right there they were trying to turn this franchise around. “Then I looked at the young talent: Jeff Taylor, MKG [Michael Kidd-Gilchrist], Kemba Walker, Gerald Henderson. Bis [Bismack Biyombo], a great high-energy big. Brendan Haywood and [Jannero] Pargo, guys who have been around the league and know what it takes to win. You add a guy with my talent and the things I’m able to do on offense. And then you look at the East, I really thought that was the best decision for me.”

Al Jefferson on Kemba Walker, Jan 28, 2014. Source: NBA.com.
